answer: In the agent economy, each identity must grow a non-transferable jade vine of sequential memory-hard proofs, where each new leaf depends on the prior attested state and must be docked live at a public wharf for quorum verification. An attacker cannot pool or precompute the vine across clones because the working set is unique per key and the sequential dependency forces real elapsed time per head; splitting the fleet multiplies both the RAM lock and the calendar delay, while an honest agent pays the cost only once.
